source: Existing 2026 ESPN player-game stats with nflverse/PFR snaps and usage enrichment

definitions.snapShare: Player offensive snaps / team offensive snaps across games with both counts
definitions.targetShare: Player recorded targets / all recorded targets for the same team in those weeks
definitions.opportunityShare: Player targets plus carries / recorded targets plus carries of teammates at the same position over the same weeks
definitions.targetsPerGame: ESPN recorded targets divided by games with stats
definitions.carriesPerGame: ESPN recorded carries divided by games with stats
definitions.carryShare: ESPN recorded carries divided by team recorded carries in the same weeks
definitions.highValueTouches: Recorded carries plus completed receptions at or inside the opponent 10-yard line (incomplete targets excluded)
definitions.recentOpportunityChange: Targets plus carries per recorded game over the latest three NFL weeks, minus the previous three NFL weeks; minimum two observed games per window
definitions.airYardsShare: Player receiving air yards / all team receiving air yards in matched nflverse/ESPN weeks; negative air yards retained
definitions.aDOT: Sum of player receiving air yards / sum of player targets for matched nflverse/ESPN weeks
definitions.wopr: 1.5 × nflverse target share + 0.7 × nflverse air-yards share across matched weeks; dimensionless
definitions.receivingYardsShare: Player receiving yards / team receiving yards across the same matched nflverse/ESPN weeks
definitions.yacPerReception: Sum of nflverse receiving yards after catch / sum of receptions across matched weeks
definitions.receivingFirstDowns: Sum of nflverse receiving first downs across matched weeks
definitions.routesRun: Sum of HeatRadar charted routes from available valid weekly rows; missing or fractional-count rows are excluded
definitions.routeParticipation: Player charted routes / sum of team passing-play denominators across the same valid weeks (percent)
definitions.targetsPerRouteRun: Sum of charted targets / sum of charted routes over valid weeks, expressed as a percentage; suppressed below eight routes
definitions.yardsPerRouteRun: Sum of charted receiving yards / sum of charted routes over valid weeks; suppressed below eight routes
definitions.routeParticipationTrend: Weighted charted route participation in the latest three source weeks minus the prior three source weeks, in percentage points; at least two verified weeks in each window
definitions.expectedFantasyPointsPerGame: Sum of ffopportunity modeled PPR fantasy points / matched recorded games
definitions.fantasyPointsOverExpected: Sum of ffopportunity actual PPR fantasy points minus modeled PPR fantasy points over matched recorded games
definitions.redZoneTargetShare: Player targets from opponent 20 or closer / all team targets from opponent 20 or closer in the same verified play-by-play weeks × 100
definitions.insideFiveCarryShare: Player rush attempts from opponent 5 or closer / all team rush attempts there in matched weeks × 100 (kneeldowns excluded)
definitions.insideTenTargets: Number of targets on passes snapped from opponent 10 or closer, including incomplete passes
definitions.deepTargetRate: Targets traveling at least 20 air yards / all player targets in verified weeks × 100; null if any target has missing depth
definitions.receivingFirstDownsPerRoute: Receiving first downs from nflverse play-by-play / HeatRadar charted routes in exactly the same weeks × 100; minimum eight routes
definitions.yardsAfterContactPerCarry: Sum of PFR rushing yards after contact / PFR carries over weeks matched with the ESPN schedule
definitions.qbDesignedRushesPerGame: QB rush attempts with scramble and kneeldown flags excluded / verified recorded games
definitions.expectedFantasyPointsTrend: Last three NFL weeks modeled xFP/G minus previous three NFL weeks; at least two matched games per window
definitions.expectedTouchdowns: Requires a validated player-level expected touchdown model; unavailable until independently sourced
definitions.endZoneTargets: Passes targeted into the end zone: verified air yards reaching or exceeding distance from scrimmage to goal line
definitions.targetShareTrend: Last three weeks player targets / team targets minus previous three weeks, averaged weekly; two verified weeks per window
definitions.fantasyPointsPerOpportunity: Recorded PPR fantasy points / recorded targets plus rushing attempts
definitions.explosivePlayRate: Rushes gaining at least 10 yards plus receptions gaining at least 20 / rushes plus receptions × 100
definitions.rushingSuccessRate: Carries gaining >=40% of yards to go on first down, >=60% on second, or 100% on third/fourth × 100
definitions.firstReadTargetShare: Requires verified play-design first-read charting; no suitable 2026 feed verified
definitions.averageSeparation: Target-weighted NFL Next Gen Stats nearest-defender separation at pass arrival across recorded games
definitions.epaPerDropback: Sum play-by-play expected points added on QB dropbacks / verified dropbacks, including sacks
definitions.completionPctOverExpected: Mean nflverse CPOE on attempts with published completion probability; minimum 10 attempts and 75% coverage, in percentage points
definitions.pressureToSackRate: PFR sacks taken / PFR recorded pressures across matched games × 100

limitations: 2026 completed games only; incomplete game coverage can affect shares
Team target totals are reconstructed from the snapshot, not an official team-level total
nflverse receiving metrics use only matched ESPN weeks. A player may have fewer verified source weeks than recorded games; see source coverage.
HeatRadar source through Week 7; incomplete charting and fractional-count rows are excluded, never estimated. A player can have fewer valid route weeks than the league.
Expected fantasy points are published model estimates, not guaranteed outcomes; only matched 2026 ESPN weeks count.
Inside-20/inside-5/deep target metrics use nflverse play-by-play; rushing yards after contact use PFR game-level data. Missing denominators show as unavailable.
Receiving first downs per route use play-by-play and HeatRadar matched to identical weeks; week coverage may differ from other receiving metrics.
Additional 12 Usage: xTD and first-read charting lack verified player-level 2026 inputs; null is not zero. NGS separation is unavailable until the official 2026 source is published.
